method: Local engine, lender pool and atomic exit executor against pinned real token and DEX code. Acquire collateral and USDG through WETH swaps. Synthetic whale inventory is sold through real pools to simulate crashes. Both oracle mocks use test-controlled pool spot prices. Each liquidation first verifies full rollback with an unacceptable profit floor, then executes atomic repayment and two-hop sale.
lifecycleAssertions: Full repayment and collateral recovery while new risk is paused and both mock feeds revert
Lender redeems capital and net interest after full repayment
No remaining engine collateral, debt, interest or approval residue
limitations: One pinned block and approximately 95 USDG loans; no production parameter approval
Mock spot-price inputs do not validate production oracle independence or manipulation resistance
Whale inventory is synthetic, not a claim about actual holder distribution
Gross margins include swap fees but exclude gas, MEV and full transaction/L1 data fees
Harness gas follows a reverted trial and is not a cold standalone transaction estimate
One selected two-hop route; no failed-route or multi-position stress coverage
Passing insolvency tests means losses are recognized, not that lenders avoid loss
